spec.deliverable: A working snake game that the user can play, delivered as a runnable app or web page.
constraints: The game must be the classic snake game: a snake that moves around, eats food and grows longer.
No extra features, modes or integrations beyond what a snake game needs.
done_criteria: The player can control the snake's direction.
The snake grows when it eats food and new food appears.
The game ends when the snake hits a wall or itself.
The game can be started and played from start to finish.
spec.summary: You want a playable snake game where you steer a snake, eat food to grow, and lose by crashing.
